title: Mingun Pahtodawgyi (unfinished pagoda)
summary: The Mingun Pahtodawgyi near Mandalay, Myanmar, is a huge brick stupa that King Bodawpaya began in 1790 and never finished. Work stopped in 1797 at about 50 metres, a third of the planned height of 152 metres, and it was not resumed after his death in 1819. An 1838 earthquake cracked the structure.

uncertainty.note: Renown Travel and Vintage News give 1790; Facts and Details and Myanmar Tours US give 1791. End is the present: the unfinished structure still stands.
